verdict.rationale: Claude Projects give you self-contained workspaces with their own knowledge bases, and project files persist across conversations. That covers the custom-knowledge part of a custom assistant. Separately, Claude Code lets teams commit instructions, skills and subagents to git to share them, but neither surface is documented as a shareable consumer assistant combining instructions and knowledge. Missing for 10: per-Project custom instructions, sharing or publishing of Projects or assistants with other users, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can build and share custom assistants with their own instructions and knowledge

citations.quote: Projects allow you to create self-contained workspaces with their own chat histories and knowledge bases.
uploaded to a project's Files section for persistent reference across conversations
Claude Code reads instructions, settings, skills, subagents, and memory from your project directory and from ~/.claude in your home directory. Commit project files to git to share them with your team
